listing.name: Shark Utility Console v1.0.0
listing.summary: Have you ever wondered how to find the exact ship that will suit your needs? Or a weapon with very specific requirements/parameters?
listing.aiSummary: Adds findships and findweapons commands to the game's console for querying ships and weapons by specific parameters.

description: Introduces two new console commands: findships and findweapons. These allow users to search for ships and weapons matching complex criteria such as size, damage type, range, or cargo capacity. The commands support flexible syntax for combining multiple conditions.
